commit.message: docs(repo-hygiene): classify remaining work and cleanup safe locals

execution.stacked_because: PR #561 normal merge is blocked by base-branch policy after an external Gemini review provider failure; admin bypass was not used.

invariants: Do not use admin bypass to merge PR #561.
Do not drop stashes in this packet.
Do not delete remote branches in this packet.
Delete local branch refs only after patch-equivalence proof and local bundle preservation.
Keep runtime, service, schema, API, and production config behavior unchanged in this hygiene packet.
Recovered runtime/docs/test work must land through separate topic PRs.

pr.body:
## Summary
- stack TP005 behind #561 because normal merge is blocked by an external Gemini review-provider failure
- classify remaining worktrees, local branches, and stashes into cleanup/topic/unfinished/dirty/blocked dispositions
- remove 7 clean worktrees and 13 patch-equivalent local branch refs after preserving a local bundle

## Validation
- packet/proof JSON validation
- git diff whitespace check
- dopemux-pr-merge self-check
- pre-commit on allowlisted packet/report/proof/index files

## Follow-up
Runtime recovery candidates remain separate topic PR inputs.

validation: Cleanup execution JSON records 7 worktree removals, 13 branch deletions, and zero failures.

validation: Validation results are recorded in proof before commit.

target: Classify remaining worktrees, local branches, and stashes after the lost-work audit; remove only clean patch-equivalent local sprawl; flag topic recovery and unfinished work without touching runtime code in this packet.
